item.title: Saga International Balloon Fiesta — Guide
item.description: The Saga International Balloon Fiesta, held each autumn (late October–early November) on the banks of the Kase River just outside Saga city, is one of Asia’s largest hot-air ballooning events and the prefecture’s signature festival. Over several days, around a hundred balloons from Japan and around the world take part in competitions and spectacular mass ascensions, when scores of brightly coloured balloons rise together into the crisp morning sky — an unforgettable sight that draws huge crowds.
